from.place: the constructible variant clause and its bounded flat constructible model

title: Etale bounded flat constructible model
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, let X be a Noetherian scheme, and let a b : ℤ with an explicit hypothesis hab : a ≤ b. For every bounded constructible object K of the derived category of sheaves of Λ-modules on the small etale site of X, K has Tor amplitude in [a,b] if and only if there exists a cochain complex P of such sheaves that is flat and constructible termwise, zero outside [a,b], and whose image in the derived category is isomorphic to K. The site and sheaf categories use [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and Tor amplitude is the derived-category Tor-amplitude notion in the cited declaration.
